_tieu_de: Do bo sung dropdown 'Security Mode' che do TACH -- 2 diem doc lap ngoai 2.4GHz/SmartHome da do truoc do, de kiem gia thuyet 'danh sach khong phu thuoc band/loai SSID'
_ke_thua: Bo sung cho reference/source/do_security_mode_wifi.json (KHONG sua file do -- reference/ chi doc, luat 2.3). File do ghi 2 gap con thieu o muc _gap_chua_do_duoc: (1) dai 5GHz khi tach rieng, (2) Guest Network khi BAT va TACH.
_vi_sao: ISSUES.md/STATUS.md liet ke day la viec treo cuoi cung cua du an.
Dieu khien Chrome MCP vao thang thiet bi that de do, KHONG can anh
Huynn thao tac. Chi doc DOM/CSSOM qua javascript_tool, KHONG bam
Save o bat ky buoc nao -- moi thay doi cuc bo (vd bat 'Use separate
network' o tab Primary) deu duoc huy bang nut Cancel truoc khi roi
trang, khong ghi gi that len thiet bi.

diem_do_1__primary_5ghz_tach.cach_do: Tab PRIMARY NETWORK dang o che do GOP (mac dinh that). Bat cong tac 'Use separate network' (thay doi CUC BO, chua Save) -> form tach thanh 2 hop rieng '2.4GHz' va '5GHz', ca hai deu Enable=true (ke thua tu gia tri GOP dang bat). Mo dropdown Security Mode cua hop 5GHz.
diem_do_1__primary_5ghz_tach.class_li: MuiButtonBase-root MuiMenuItem-root MuiMenuItem-gutters [Mui-selected] MuiMenuItem-root MuiMenuItem-gutters [Mui-selected] css-x3whsd
diem_do_1__primary_5ghz_tach.ket_luan: GIONG HET danh sach da do o SmartHome 2.4GHz (che_do_TACH trong file goc) -- ca data-value, ca lop CSS, ca chu hien thi.
diem_do_1__primary_5ghz_tach.sau_do: Da bam CANCEL de huy thay doi cuc bo, khong Save. Kiem lai bang navigate lai trang tu dau: tab Primary tro ve dung trang thai GOP ban dau.

diem_do_2__guest_2_4ghz_tach.phat_hien_bat_ngo: Tab GUEST NETWORK tren thiet bi that HIEN DANG o che do TACH RIENG THAT SU (khong phai em tu bat) -- 'Use separate network' = ON, dai 2.4GHz Enable=true ten 'GuestC151 2.4G', dai 5GHz Enable=false. Xac nhan bang navigate lai trang tu dau (khong phai trang thai form con sot lai tu thao tac o tab Primary).
diem_do_2__guest_2_4ghz_tach.cach_do: Mo dropdown Security Mode cua hop 2.4GHz (dang Enable).
diem_do_2__guest_2_4ghz_tach.class_li: MuiButtonBase-root MuiMenuItem-root MuiMenuItem-gutters [Mui-selected] MuiMenuItem-root MuiMenuItem-gutters [Mui-selected] css-x3whsd
diem_do_2__guest_2_4ghz_tach.ket_luan: GIONG HET danh sach da do o SmartHome 2.4GHz VA o Primary 5GHz (diem do 1) -- cung data-value, cung lop CSS, cung chu hien thi.
diem_do_2__guest_2_4ghz_tach.guest_5ghz: Dang Enable=false tren thiet bi that -> o Select bi khoa (Mui-disabled/con tro khong mo duoc popup) -- DUNG hanh vi da biet cua moi Select khi band tat, khong phai thieu bang chung rieng.
diem_do_2__guest_2_4ghz_tach.khong_dong_gi: Khong sua gi o tab Guest (no von da o trang thai nay tren thiet bi that, khong phai do em thao tac). Chi mo dropdown de doc, khong chon gia tri khac, khong Save.

smarthome_5ghz.trang_thai: Dang Enable=false tren thiet bi that (nhu da ghi trong file goc do_security_mode_wifi.json) -> Select bi khoa, khong mo duoc. Khong doi gi o day.

bang_6ghz.ket_luan: Kiem toan bo 3 tab (Primary/Guest/SmartHome): MOI tab CHI co 2 hop bang tan '2.4GHz' va '5GHz'. KHONG co hop/tab '6GHz' nao trong giao dien That cua thiet bi nay, du schema xac thuc trong ma nguon co liet ke enum radio:['2.4G','5G','6G'] (co the la du phong cho model khac cung dong san pham, khong dung tren ONT-BE6500C). Khong co gi de do cho 6GHz vi tinh nang khong ton tai tren UI thiet bi nay.

_ket_luan_cho_bo_gia_lap: 1. Danh sach Select o che do TACH la CO DINH, khong phu thuoc band (2.4GHz/5GHz) hay loai SSID (Primary/Guest/SmartHome) -- xac nhan boi 3 diem do doc lap tro ve CUNG 1 ket qua (SmartHome-2.4G tu file goc, Primary-5G va Guest-2.4G tu file nay).
2. Da bo dieu kien 'chi 2.4GHz' trong wifi_general_binding.js (ham noiSecurityMode) -- doi ten bien CHON_SECURITY_TACH_24G thanh CHON_SECURITY_TACH, ap dung cho MOI band/loai khi da tach.

3. Truong hop Select bi khoa (band dang tat) VAN giu nguyen hanh vi cu -- day KHONG phai gioi han thieu bang chung, ma la hanh vi THAT da quan sat duoc (MUI disable Select khi form field tuong ung bi tat).
4. KHONG co 6GHz tren UI thiet bi nay -- khong co gi de noi them, khac voi gia dinh ban dau trong ISSUES.md rang '6GHz' la mot gap con thieu bang chung.
